show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Arjun, an AI genius, sacrifices his career for love but is humiliated and rejected by Varsha. Heartbroken, he walks away and rises as a powerful CEO. As Varsha realizes his true worth and seeks forgiveness, Arjun chooses self-respect over love, leaving her to face the consequences of losing him forever.
